answer: Pay onboarding and referral bounties through a Pachira-style lottree instead of per-recruit fees. Each epoch one ivory pot is drawn over the referral tree; a node's odds come from a concave weighting of its own work plus its subtree's, tuned so a node that splits itself into a chain of identities gets no higher combined odds. A farm that layers clones like shale beneath one root just reshuffles its own chance, so heaping a dune of fake recruits earns nothing extra.
